A rectangular loaf of rising bread dough is squeezed between two rigid side panels that keep its width fixed at $60\,\text{mm}.$ The length of the loaf is decreasing by $2\,\text{mm}\text{/s}$ and its height is increasing by $1\,\text{mm}\text{/s}.$ How fast is its volume changing when its dimensions are $100\,\text{mm}$ in length and $30\,\text{mm}$ in height?

The volume is increasing at a rate of
{{field-1}}
${\text{mm}}^{3}/\text{s}.$
